"Liquids cannot transmit pressure" is the incorrect statement.

The other two are true statements about pressure in fluids.

So I is the one that is not correct.

text: In a hydraulic press, a force of 46N is applied to a piston of area 4cm². Calculate the force produced on a second piston of area 32cm².
explanation:
Pressure is transmitted equally throughout the fluid.

\(\frac{F_1}{A_1} = \frac{F_2}{A_2}\)

\(F_2 = \frac{46 \times 32}{4} = 368\)N

text: Which of the following statements about pressure in fluids is correct? I. Pressure in a liquid acts only downwards II. Pressure in a liquid increases with depth III. Liquids cannot transmit pressure
explanation:
Pressure in a liquid increases with depth — this is correct.

The other two statements are not true: "Liquids cannot transmit pressure" and "Pressure in a liquid acts only downwards" both misstate the physics.

So only II is correct.
